application_conditions: Any platform (Discord, X, website, newsletter); no website required. Apply via Impact.com; review "usually within 1 week" with an email on approval; partner handbook after approval. Support by Acceleration Partners and internal account managers.
paid_action: Referring new customers; each commissionable action validated before payment (per-product actions in contract).
validation_conditions: Only Crypto.com-communicated new-customer incentives allowed; other codes may make referrals untrackable.

commission.model_note: 'Earn up to 50% commission': revenue share across multiple products plus 'other product bonuses'; fixed commission plan based on number of referred customers and trading volume; per-product rates and product list only in the contract and vary by country; 'no monthly maximum'; 'performance marketing program' — earnings not guaranteed; 'Typical results data is not currently available'. Nothing stated for the Visa card (appears only in site navigation).

revenue_share.duration_note: Earnings from a referred customer generally run 180–365 days after KYC completion

payout.holdbacks_note: Each commissionable action has a validation period; after validation Crypto.com is invoiced and partners are paid once funds clear (Impact.com). Validation period length not specified.

rules_note: Cannot be based in or promote to countries where affiliate marketing is prohibited or the app is unavailable (list in contract). Brand bidding and email rules not stated.
